column1: # browser-script.tsv (harbor#1507): the fixed scripts `harbor chrome` runs in a page for its script-first verbs.
# WHY: macOS reports a page `hidden` when its window is covered, and Playwright's click waits for paint, so a click
# on a covered agent window timed out (64 in 3 days, 2026-11-10..12). These dispatch the events on the element and
# need no paint: live 2026-11-12 on a hidden window they opened a dialog and a menu, switched a tab, followed a link.
# Both routes read this file (bin/access-chrome-mcp.ts, bin/access-browser-agent.sh), so they cannot drift.
# The code is fixed: the agent supplies only a snapshot ref, and __ARG__ is replaced with a JSON literal (a check's
# true or false, a select's list of values, a scroll's pixels or null). Free-form eval stays refused.
# Each returns two lines: what it did (or `refused: ` / `unchanged: `), then `- Page URL: <url>`.

column2: (el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), o = { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true, view: window, clientX: r.x + r.width / 2, clientY: r.y + r.height / 2, button: 0 }, p = { ...o, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', isPrimary: true }; const end = (s) => s + '\n- Page URL: ' + location.href; if (el.disabled === true || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || el.closest('[inert]')) return end('refused: the element is disabled'); const press = () => { el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { ...p, buttons: 1 })); el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { ...o, buttons: 1 })); if (el.focus) el.focus({ preventScroll: true }); el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', p)); el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', o)); if (typeof el.click === 'function') el.click(); else el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', o)); }; press(); return end('clicked ' + el.tagName.toLowerCase() + ' by script'); }
